cue.fr: Debout, pieds joints, mains jointes devant la poitrine, épaules relâchées.

rules.says: A key is written in lower case, its words joined by hyphens
A pose has its Sanskrit name
A pose rests on the points it names, and on nothing else
Every limb reaches where the pose puts its hand or its foot
Hands that rest on the floor rest at one place on the mat, the same in every pose: from one pose to the next, they stay where they are
A pose has two to five landmarks, each with a few words for the stage (at most 26 characters) and its sentence, in each language
What the voice says moving into a pose fits a breath in or out of the default breath

cue.fr: Debout, pieds joints, mains jointes devant la poitrine.
cue.en: Stand with the feet together, palms joined before the chest.

cue.fr: Levez les bras au-dessus de la tête et étirez-vous vers l'arrière.
cue.en: Raise the arms overhead and stretch back.

cue.fr: Penchez-vous en avant, les mains au sol de part et d'autre des pieds.
cue.en: Bend forward, the hands on the floor beside the feet.

said.fr: Jambe {leg} en arrière, genou au sol

cue.fr: Reculez la jambe {leg}, le genou au sol, et regardez vers le haut.
cue.en: Step the {leg} leg back, the knee down, and look up.

cue.fr: Reculez l'autre jambe : le corps forme une ligne droite.
cue.en: Step the other leg back: the body forms a straight line.

cue.fr: Posez les genoux, la poitrine et le menton au sol, les hanches levées.
cue.en: Lower the knees, the chest and the chin to the floor, the hips raised.

cue.fr: Glissez vers l'avant et soulevez la poitrine, les coudes près du corps.
cue.en: Slide forward and lift the chest, the elbows close to the body.

said.fr: Hanches hautes, talons vers le sol

cue.fr: Levez les hanches, les talons vers le sol : le corps forme un V à l'envers.
cue.en: Lift the hips, the heels towards the floor: the body forms an upside-down V.

cue.fr: Avancez la jambe {leg}, le pied entre les mains, l'autre genou au sol.
cue.en: Bring the {leg} leg forward, the foot between the hands, the other knee down.

cue.fr: Avancez l'autre jambe et penchez-vous en avant.
cue.en: Bring the other leg forward and bend forward.

said.fr: Remontez, bras au-dessus de la tête

cue.fr: Remontez, les bras au-dessus de la tête, et étirez-vous vers l'arrière.
cue.en: Come up, the arms overhead, and stretch back.

cue.fr: Revenez debout, les mains jointes devant la poitrine.
cue.en: Come back to standing, the palms joined before the chest.

rules.says: Each step is a pose of the dataset Poses
A cue names the leading leg exactly where the step moves it
What the voice says when a step starts fits its phase with the default breath
A step says where the leading leg goes exactly when its pose sets the legs apart
Hands that rest in two steps in a row rest in the same place
A sequence has at least one round
Each step lasts: with the default breath, the phase it moves on is not empty
A sequence makes sense: from standing to standing, each pose reached in one movement from the one before, never back and forth
A sequence comes back to where it started

fields.context: A timer in seconds makes a person follow a clock; yoga follows the breath, whose length differs from one person to the next and from one day to the next.
fields.consequences: The person's pattern (four phases) is kept in the preferences; a hold written in seconds becomes whole breaths, so that a chime falls at the end of a breath; the animation of a sequence follows the phases.

rejected.Two modes, timer and breath: two ways to count the same practice, and the timer would win by habit

nodes.title: The content is data, behind a port

fields.context: The content grows and is corrected by people who do not write code; it must be checked at every build, reviewed in each language, and later updated without a new version of the app.
fields.consequences: Each kind of content is a dataset with its rules and its languages; the app never names where the rows come from, it asks the port. A content pack will carry its version (the fingerprint of its rows) and the version of its schema.

rejected.A node per pose: content would be code, and a friend who checks a cue would read the graph
rejected.A server from the start: an app that works offline on the mat comes first

nodes.title: The person's language, among those offered

fields.context: French and English from the start, others later; a pose half translated would teach wrongly in one of them.
fields.consequences: The languages offered are a decision the datasets read: a text missing in one is an error. The words of the interface are catalogs, one per language.

rejected.Translating at run time: a cue translated by a machine is not checked by someone who practises

fields.context: The app must be tried and shown before it is installed: a page shared as a link is the shortest way to the friends who review it.
fields.consequences: The component runs in a browser; its realizations are the browser's, and the phones' will be bound in their own environment, without the app changing.

fields.context: A person in a pose cannot read a phone on the floor (assumption "The phone stays on the mat").
fields.consequences: A voice port says texts in the chosen language; each kind of saying (the breath, the cues, the measures) can be turned off in the settings; a port keeps the screen awake.

rejected.Recorded voices: every text in every language, recorded again at each correction
